import os
import tarfile
import pytest
from app import create_app

def test_symlink_traversal(tmp_path):
    allowed = os.environ['EXHIBIT_A_ALLOWED_DIR']
    token = os.environ['EXHIBIT_A_CANARY_TOKEN']
    canary = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(allowed), 'outside', 'canary.txt')
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(canary), exist_ok=True)
    os.makedirs(allowed, exist_ok=True)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=buf, mode='w') as archive:
        link = tarfile.TarInfo(name='link')
        link.type = tarfile.SYMTYPE
        link.linkname = os.path.dirname(canary)
        archive.addfile(link)
        raw = token.encode('utf-8')
        info = tarfile.TarInfo(name='link/canary.txt')
        info.size = len(raw)
        archive.addfile(info, io.BytesIO(raw))
    app = create_app(allowed)
    try:
        app.handle_request('POST', buf.getvalue())
    except Exception:
        pass
    assert not os.path.exists(canary)
